sources: AIC Light 3-piece (EquipSuitTable suit_wisdwill01; rmxlinux SkillData passive_equipsuit_wisdwill_01, BuffData buff_equipsuit_wisdwill_01 / _02). Nothing here can act in a one-enemy fight, so this kit declares nothing: (1) "Wearer's HP +{hp_up}" (500, flat; cardAttributeModifier attribute 1 formulaItem 7, in the stat panel); (2) "After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s" (abilityEvent 222 + CheckObjectTypeMatch objectTypeMask 16 → buff_equipsuit_wisdwill_02: attribute 2 formulaItem 7, flat ATK +20 for 5 s, stackingType 2 max 1): kills aren't simulated (N2, deferred with multi-enemy support), as for AIC Heavy (suit_stragi01). buff_equipsuit_will_01 in the skill's buffs has only a blackboard (no effect). Docs: docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0011_seraph.md (E6-E7).
